```{r}
library(ggplot2)
expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1 <- readRDS("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/paom/expr_pseudotime.rds")
```

```{r}
colnames(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1)
expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1$marker
```


```{r}
cols_pll = c("cyan","blue","hotpink", "red")
cluster_labels=c("early_HBG","late_HBG","early_HBB", "late_HBB")
```


```{r}
ggplot(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1, aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=HBG2,color=active_cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values=setNames(cols_pll,cluster_labels))+
  geom_point(size=0.25)+
  ylim(0, NA)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth(data = expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1,
              aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=HBG2),
              method = "loess",
              inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(marker))
```

```{r}
NME_plot <- ggplot(expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1, aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2,color=HBG2, shape=active_cluster))+
  geom_point(size=0.25)+
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high="yellow")+
  #guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+
  #scale_color_manual(values=setNames(cols_pll,cluster_labels))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth(data = expression_table_with_pseudotime_leiden_mod1,
              aes(x=pseudotime_coordinate,y=NME2),
              method = "loess",
              inherit.aes = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#soft cutoff
RBC <- readRDS("/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/sanger22/scRNAseq_Cordblood/Cordblood_MS2022/hemoglobin_containing_dataset.rds")
```
```{r}
table(RBC@active.ident)
#move soft cutoff to metadata
RBC$softCO <- Idents(RBC)
```

```{r}
RBC <- RenameIdents(object = RBC, 'early_HBG' = "HBG")
RBC <- RenameIdents(object = RBC, 'early_HBB' = "HBB")
RBC <- RenameIdents(object = RBC, 'late_HBG' = "HBG")
RBC <- RenameIdents(object = RBC, 'late_HBB' = "HBB")
RBC$marker <- Idents(RBC)
table(RBC$marker)
```

```{r}
library(hrbrthemes)
library(Seurat)
#RBC$softCO <- Idents(RBC)
Idents(RBC) <- RBC$softCO
DefaultAssay(RBC) <- "RNA"
RBC_expr <- as.data.frame(GetAssayData(object = RBC, slot = "data"))
```

```{r}
Meta_data <- RBC@meta.data
RBC_expr <- t(RBC_expr)
genes <- c("HBA1", "NME2", "MTF2", "YBX3", "ETS2", "DNMT1")
RBC_expr <- as.data.frame(RBC_expr)

RBC_expr_subset <- RBC_expr[ ,c("HBA1","NME2", "MTF2", "YBX3", "ETS2", "DNMT1")]
RBC_expr_subset <- cbind(RBC_expr_subset, Meta_data)
```



```{r}
cols_pll = c("cyan","blue","hotpink", "red")
cluster_labels=c("early_HBG","late_HBG","early_HBB", "late_HBB")
```

```{r}
colnames(Meta_data)
```

```{r}
RBC_expr_subset$rownames <- rownames(RBC_expr_subset)
rownames(RBC_expr_subset) = NULL
```

```{r}
NME2_p <- ggplot(RBC_expr_subset, aes(x=HBA1, y=NME2, color=softCO))+
  scale_color_manual(values=setNames(cols_pll,cluster_labels))+
  geom_point(size=0.25)+
  ylim(0, NA)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_smooth(data = RBC_expr_subset,
              aes(x=HBA1, y=NME2),
              method = "loess",
              inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(marker))
```
